staging_note: STAGED DESIGN COPY, not wired. Pisces's pool is shipped; chatted_with_pisces accrues today. Two stages — he only ever thaws to 'tolerable', and that is the joke and the tragedy both.

lines: Ah. You. Acceptable timing — I was on the verge of being bored, and you are marginally better than boredom. I do not say that to many.
Your channel has stopped embarrassing you, I trust. Good. I dislike wasted instruction; it reflects on the instructor.
The bread stall raises its prices after the fourth bell. Buy before. There — advice worth coin, given freely. Note the date.

greet_options.text: You hold yourself like a swordsman, not a scholar.
greet_options._flag: CANON ⚑ tread-light — father a [Fencer] is staged (mild); the sold-rapier line is an OBLIQUE Wistram-era nod. HARD RAILS in the .md: no expulsion cause, no deaths, no Az'kerash, no Ceria specifics.

pisces_fence.speaker: Pisces
pisces_fence.text: ...Observant. A rapier, in fact, before any of this. My father's trade — his grip, his footwork, his opinions on both. I set it down for magic, and he has yet to forgive either of us. The footwork stayed. It wins me arguments the diction loses.

pisces_fence_two.speaker: Pisces
pisces_fence_two.text: I sold the blade years ago, when circumstances were... instructive. One does not miss a thing so much as the hands remember it. A sniff. Next question — preferably about magic, which unlike the past improves under examination.

perk.summary: ⚑ NO SPEC DEFAULT — proposal (user picks or strikes): (a) 'a duelist's drill' — once per waking, ask Pisces to drill your casting: full MP restore in the field, diegetic 'second breath' callback to his own lesson_mana copy; needs the per-waking dedup seam (entity_first_use verb-prefix) + an MP-restore-outside-sleep hook. (b) one-time gift: his practice focus, a trinket item (items.json shape exists; effect fields for MP would be new). (a) reads more like him — he'd never give an object away, he WOULD show off pedagogy.
